## Why This Is Asked
This question probes the ability to build a robust, privacy-aware multilingual NLP system that handles code-switching and low-resource languages in real-time production environments.

## Key Concepts
- Multilingual transformers (XLM-RoBERTa, mBERT) with code-switching robustness

- Active learning pipelines across low-resource languages
- Real-time drift detection (PSI, Kolmogorov-Smirnov) and canary rollouts

stream

  .pipe(logToAnalytics)

- What strategies would you use for handling languages with minimal training data?
- How do you ensure fair toxicity detection across all 6 languages?
